name: Bloodfury Trinkets
summary: Mor'rogal asks you to bring him sunstones from the Bloodfury harpies in the Charred Vale. He says they are bound to the lights of the skies.

sections.title: Harpies' Stones
sections.body: The Bloodfury harpies gather shiny things, among them golden-yellow sunstones. Mor'rogal is up on the hills above you and has mentioned using them. He asks you to bring him any Glittering Sunstones you find.

sections.title: Light in Stone
sections.body: Mor'rogal says sunstones reflect the sun's majesty. They can adorn shrines and homes with small motes of light. At night, the moon lends them its silver beauty. To him, they recall a bond with the lights of the skies.

faq.q: What are the Bloodfury harpies collecting?
faq.answer: The Bloodfury harpies gather shiny objects, including golden-yellow sunstones.
Mor'rogal, who is up on the hills above you, has mentioned using sunstones.

faq.q: What does Mor'rogal use sunstones for?
faq.answer: Mor'rogal says sunstones can adorn shrines and homes with small motes of light.

faq.q: What do the sunstones mean to Mor'rogal?
faq.answer: The sunstones remind Mor'rogal of a bond with the lights of the skies.
